intro: Trying to find USA scholarships for international students with a December deadline usually means balancing urgency with fit. This filtered slice brings together a focused set of listings so you can apply sooner, compare options, and avoid mixing late-cycle programs with opportunities that may need attention earlier. The rows here span subjects such as education, STEM, medicine, humanities, and community-focused awards, with examples that also touch engineering, communication, and business-related study. Awards vary by listing, requirements are mixed, and some programs may ask for essays while others appear lighter-touch. Because deadline wording and eligibility details differ across these entries, it is worth reading each row carefully and verifying the official terms before you move forward.
